# Citation and publication information {.unnumbered}

This book is currently an unpublished draft edited by Eimear Dolan and James Steele. Final publication metadata are awaiting confirmation.

The planned publisher is [Kinesiology Books](https://kinesiologybooks.org/index.php/stork/index), in association with STORK. The press will supply the book and chapter DOIs. No DOI, publication date, ISBN, final licence or permanent site address has been assigned in this setup.

Chapter authors are identified at the beginning of each chapter. Please verify the final version and its publication details before citing the published book or a chapter.
